spans.s:
m. (-यः)
SĀTYAKI, the charioteer of KṚṢṆA.

mfn. (-हः-ही-हं)
Lion, leonine, lion-like.
E.
सिंह a lion, अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Lion, leonine.
m. (-कः)
RĀHU, the personified ascending node.
E.
सिंह, and ठक् aff.; or सिंहिका the mother of RĀHU, (by adoption,) and अण् patronymic aff.

m. (-यः)
RĀHU, the personified ascending node.
E.
सिंहिका the reputed mother of this being, and ढक् aff.

n. (-त्यं)
The command of an army, the dignity or duty of a general.
E.
सेनापति a general, and यक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating or belonging to an army, drawn up as an army, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A guard, a centinel, a piquet.
2 A body of forces in array.
E.
सेना an array, and ठक् aff.

Marine, aquatic, ocean or river-born.
m. (-वः)
A horse.
mn. (-वः-वं)
Rock salt.
n. (-वं)
In dramatic literature, musical expression of disappointment with Prākṛta words.
f. (-वी)
One of the Rāgiṇīs.
E.
सिन्धु a river, &c., अण् aff.

m. (-नः)
A lump of salt.
E.
सैन्धव, and घन thick.

n. (-न्यं)
An army.
m. (-न्यः)
1 A soldier under arms, one drawn up in array.
2 A guard, a centinel.
E.
सेना an army, and ण्य or ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-तिः)
A general.
E.
सैन्य, and अधिपति ruler.

m. (-क्षः)
A commander, a general.
E.
सैन्य, and अध्यक्ष supervisor.
